Method Detail

getScriptCode

public char getScriptCode()
Returns a code that describe the script to use. Possible codes are 'l' for latin, 'b' for latin bold, 'i' for latin italic, '+' for comments, 't' for transliteration, 'c' for coptic, 'g' for greek, 'r' for cyrillic, 'h' for hebrew.

Returns:
the script code.
